name: zoolutions
description: Shared Claude Code machinery for the zoolutions, hldesign and getzazu repositories. Knowledge stays in each repo; the machinery that reads and grows it lives here.

plugins.name: lode
plugins.description: Per-repo memory (lode/), a pre-PR gate enforced by a push hook, and the shared workflows /lode:lfg, /lode:review-pr, /lode:finish-prs, /lode:debug-flaky, /lode:tdd and /lode:plan, which read lode/workflow.md so one copy serves every repository.
